name: Summer
description: Pulse counter with floating-point steps. Like Stepper but accepts a float step size, so each trigger increments the running sum by that amount. From sc3-plugins SummerUGens.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger — increments on transition from non-positive to positive

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Float step size added on each trigger

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset trigger — sets the counter to resetval when fired

inputs.name: resetval
inputs.description: Value to reset the counter to on reset trigger

name: WrapSummer
description: Pulse counter with floating-point steps that wraps around min and max bounds. Like Summer but the counter wraps modulo (max - min). From sc3-plugins SummerUGens.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger — increments on transition from non-positive to positive

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Float step size added on each trigger

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Minimum value of the counter (lower wrap bound)

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Maximum value of the counter (upper wrap bound)

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset trigger — sets the counter to resetval when fired

inputs.name: resetval
inputs.description: Value to reset the counter to on reset trigger (defaults to min if unset)
